target_customer: Consumers, mostly young adults who log and share places with friends (current site); YC page and App Store listing describe a travel and flight deals app
problem: People want to keep and share ranked lists of places they have visited with friends rather than scattered notes and reviews.
product_category: Consumer social app for logging and ranking places

competitors.name: Beli
competitors.what: Social app to log and rank restaurants by head to head comparison
competitors.traction_then: Gained popularity in 2023 and more in 2025, mostly via referrals
competitors.funding_then: Aggregator lists a 2023 Series A, unverified

technical_complexity.rationale: A mobile app with ranking and social features is standard consumer engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Social graph and accumulated rankings could create lock in, but Beli had a head start and others could add the feature.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying outcome found.

market_need_then: Beli's growth among Gen Z in 2023 to 2025 showed interest in social restaurant ranking; whether Vaya serves a separate need is unclear.

branding.domain_note: Uses flyvaya.com, an exact .com for vaya was not obtained; the site name suggests a flights origin.

identity.visual_style: Landing page is mostly an app screenshot
identity.voice_and_tone: Brief and plain: 'Log and share your places with friends.'

brand_strength.rationale: Many unrelated apps and companies share the name Vaya (Africa ride hailing, Botswana transit, concierge driving), and no brand press or community was found.

pivots.from: Travel and flight deals app (per YC page text and App Store listing)
pivots.to: Social app for ranking, logging and sharing places
pivots.why: Not stated; the dataset one liner and the site describe places, while search results show a flight deals listing under the same name. The operator on the site is Fix AI, Inc.

outcome_analysis: Vaya is a two person Fall 2024 YC consumer company whose public identity is unclear: the YC profile text and an App Store listing describe flight deals, while the dataset one liner and its website describe a social app for ranking and sharing places, run by Fix AI, Inc. No funding, traction or exit data is public, and the main contemporaneous competitor, Beli, had already gained traction, so no outcome can be judged.
notes: Conflict: sources describe both flight deals and place logging under the same name; I could not confirm which is current or whether a pivot occurred. Funding searches found nothing for this Vaya (other Vayas such as a Delhi astrology startup raised money, unrelated). Competitor list covers only the place ranking reading; flight deal competitors were not researched. Team size 2 from YC.
